g.text: Repeat the PbS deposition and EDT treatment
Selected operation defines the material and layer
Illustrative plane · no inferred stack or dimensional scale
Inputs: Rinsed substrate bearing the EDT-treated PbS layer; Oleate-capped PbS quantum dots;
Hexane; isomer not specified; 1,2-Ethanedithiol; Isopropanol; Acetonitrile
Output: Repeat the PbS deposition and EDT treatment
Repeat the preceding PbS spin coating, EDT treatment and ACN rinsing to obtain two PbS-EDT
layers in total; this is one repeated layer cycle, not two additional layers.
Qualified action illustration; no unreported vessel dimensions, hardware, measured
molecular geometry, or experimental trace is implied.
Source: SI PDF pp.6–7, Section 8, Solar cell fabrication
